name: @chethandvg/biological-rhythms-dataset
description: Measured frequencies and timings of early life, from sperm tail beat to embryonic heart rate, each value with its species, method and DOI.
author: Chethan Dandebala Venkatarama

scripts.build: cargo build --release --target wasm32-unknown-unknown && wasm-bindgen --target nodejs --out-dir pkg/node target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/biological_rhythms_dataset_wasm.wasm && wasm-bindgen --target web --out-dir pkg/web target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/biological_rhythms_dataset_wasm.wasm
